title: The Emotional Ambush
subtitle: A public criticism arrives while you are already overloaded. Your job is to stay regulated, clarify what matters, and choose the next useful action.

blocks.text: Do not read ahead. Write your first 90 seconds. What do you observe? What do you say? What do you verify? What do you do first?

The resourceful move is usually not the cleverest sentence. It is the action that improves the quality of the situation: reduce heat, increase clarity, protect safety, find evidence, identify ownership, and create a next step. Adapt the order to the stakes.

items: Can I use the core tools from LEVEL 1 — GET YOURSELF TOGETHER under pressure?
Can I explain what not to do?
Can I adapt rather than follow a checklist blindly?
Can I create evidence of capability in real life?

blocks.text: Separate observation from interpretation, challenge assumptions, and reason clearly.
